S.FORM: I tini i sawaliay a 'apilis no Yu - Shan hananay, oya satakaraway a lotok no Taywan i, adihay ko sa'owac. I tini i saetipay a tafiling no pasawali a lotok i, matira to a adihay ko sa'owac. Saka ma- sopsop ko nanom no nani waliay ato nani etipay a kalosa'owa'owac i, mala- sawa'eran no Siwkulan hananay a tara- wadaw. I tini i la'ed no Posko ato Kohkoh i, masadafdaf ko sera i tira, saka masaca- pacapa' ko sonol no nanom i tira. O ka- olahan no kapah no i lilisay no Tarawa- daw a niyaroaro' a mikomoris a mifuting i tira tora kasacapacapa' no tarawadaw i tiyaho. Roma i, satatad san ko cecay na- niyaro'an a cilowad to komoris. Roma i, malaladof ko pina- pina:ay a niyaro' a ci- lowad to komoris. Caay ko pifuting aca a cecay ko pato- sokan a mikomoris, o sa- pipalatamdawaw to kapah ko sakakaay a patosokan no i tiraay a Pangcah. I tini i cepo' no fadangaw hananay a sa'owac i sawalian no Kohkoh i, pasa- wali a mapiko ko likid no nanom. I tira a miteka mifalat a miketon to lotok no pa- sawali tangasa i cepo' no nini a Tarawa- daw i pariyar. Adihay ko kahirahira no futing i nanom no tarawadaw, saka ka- olahan no pangcah a mifuting i tira. I tira saca i cepo' no nini a tarawadaw misa- cepo' a mifuting ko niyaro' no Maku- taay. Anini sato, onini a Siwkulan ha- nanay a tarawadaw i, caayto ko pifu- tingan no Pangcah a cecay. O ka- olahan to no i cowacowaay a lafang a mikihadoy to tata'akay a dadangoyan nani tini i Kohkoh tangasa i cepo'.
S.PHON: i tini i sawaɾiaj a ʡapiɾis no~u jo~u~u - sħan ħananaj, o~uja satakarawaj a ɾo~uto~uk no~u tajwan i, aɬ~ɮiħaj ko~u saʡo~uwaʦ. i tini i saətipaj a tafiɾiŋ no~u pasawaɾi a ɾo~uto~uk i, matira to~u a aɬ~ɮiħaj ko~u saʡo~uwaʦ. saka ma- so~upso~up ko~u nano~um no~u nani waɾiaj ato~u nani ətipaj a kaɾo~usaʡo~uwaʡo~uwaʦ i, maɾa- sawaʡəran no~u siwko~u~uɾan ħananaj a tara- waɬ~ɮaw. i tini i ɾaʡəɬ~ɮ no~u po~usko~u ato~u ko~uħko~uħ i, masaɬ~ɮafɬ~ɮaf ko~u səra i tira, saka masaʦa- paʦapaʡ ko~u so~uno~uɾ no~u nano~um i tira. o~u ka- o~uɾaħan no~u kapaħ no~u i ɾiɾisaj no~u tarawa- ɬ~ɮaw a nijaro~uaro~uʡ a miko~umo~uris a mifo~u~utiŋ i tira to~ura kasaʦapaʦapaʡ no~u tarawaɬ~ɮaw i tijaħo~u. ro~uma i, satataɬ~ɮ san ko~u ʦəʦaj na- nijaro~uʡan a ʦiɾo~uwaɬ~ɮ to~u ko~umo~uris. ro~uma i, maɾaɾaɬ~ɮo~uf ko~u pina- pina:aj a nijaro~uʡ a ʦi- ɾo~uwaɬ~ɮ to~u ko~umo~uris. ʦaaj ko~u pifo~u~utiŋ aʦa a ʦəʦaj ko~u pato~u- so~ukan a miko~umo~uris, o~u sa- pipaɾatamɬ~ɮawaw to~u kapaħ ko~u sakakaaj a pato~uso~ukan no~u i tiraaj a paŋʦaħ. i tini i ʦəpo~uʡ no~u faɬ~ɮaŋaw ħananaj a saʡo~uwaʦ i sawaɾian no~u ko~uħko~uħ i, pasa- waɾi a mapiko~u ko~u ɾikiɬ~ɮ no~u nano~um. i tira a mitəka mifaɾat a mikəto~un to~u ɾo~uto~uk no~u pa- sawaɾi taŋasa i ʦəpo~uʡ no~u nini a tarawa- ɬ~ɮaw i parijar. aɬ~ɮiħaj ko~u kaħiraħira no~u fo~u~utiŋ i nano~um no~u tarawaɬ~ɮaw, saka ka- o~uɾaħan no~u paŋʦaħ a mifo~u~utiŋ i tira. i tira saʦa i ʦəpo~uʡ no~u nini a tarawaɬ~ɮaw misa- ʦəpo~uʡ a mifo~u~utiŋ ko~u nijaro~uʡ no~u mako~u~u- taaj. anini sato~u, o~unini a siwko~u~uɾan ħa- nanaj a tarawaɬ~ɮaw i, ʦaajto~u ko~u pifo~u~u- tiŋan no~u paŋʦaħ a ʦəʦaj. o~u ka- o~uɾaħan to~u no~u i ʦo~uwaʦo~uwaaj a ɾafaŋ a mikiħaɬ~ɮo~uj to~u tataʡakaj a ɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮaŋo~ujan nani tini i ko~uħko~uħ taŋasa i ʦəpo~uʡ.
